No free-form shell. v5: + seed-setting. v6: key allows '-' and 'finance.'. v7: + nginx-access (path, lines; time/method/path/status only), + env-has (name; set/unset only, never the value). v8: deploy calls box-local scripts/deploy-local.sh when present (T-606), else the inline body. v9: + seed-courts (yarn workspace @lawie/drafting seed:courts, upsert-only, env loaded like deploy). v10: + env-set (envkey allow-list, never a secret name; prints only 'set <key>'), + puppeteer-chrome (install puppeteer's Chrome as ubuntu, restart drafting, health). v11: + backfill-free-seed (T-657 DRY RUN only, counts only; ids file 0600 on the box, deleted at the end). v12: backfill cut-off 2026-10-25T20:00:00Z (Ajay, AJ-657-M1d). v13: env-set allows JWT_EXPIRES_IN (founder, T-616). v14: + get-setting (read one feature.* AppSetting; prints key=value or key unset). v15: + count-generations (generations only; per templateId counts before/after since, plus _id/runId/status/createdAt, cap 200). v16: + generation-latency (generations last 24 h / 7 d by templateId+status: count, p50/p95 durationMs; numbers only). v17: + log-window (drafting pm2 out+error logs: JSON lines within ±5 s of since, plain lines naming runid; whitelisted fields only, quoted text stripped). v18: + token-stats (llm_call token stats from drafting out logs by stage/call/model; per-draft token stats from generations; numbers only). v19: + token-totals (token sums per model x stage for 24h / 7d / month-to-date from drafting llm_call logs, and per aiModel from generations split by runOrigin; numbers only). v20: + timeline (one run: generations times; llm_call times, nginx access lines with hashed client and id-masked paths in a window; nginx proxy/timeout directives). Timestamps and codes only. v21: + git-remote (origin URL with userinfo masked, credential helper name, credential file present y/n, ~/.ssh file names; never a token or key). v22: + migrate-model-settings (T-684; mode dryrun|apply, default dryrun; prints key names and counts only). v23: migrate-model-settings apply passes --apply literally inside the heredoc (v22 lost the flag). v24: + env-flag (FEATURE_DEFAULT_FACT_LEDGER / FEATURE_DEFAULT_DESCRIBE_FIRST only; prints on, off, other or unset). v25: + backfill-payments (T-646; mode dryrun|apply; counts only, payment/subscription ids never printed).
